title: Continuous cognitive production / geometric useful growth

human_intent.primary: Use many identical fresh /wc chats as a continuously replenished cognitive production pool that advances all useful projects without making the human manually route, merge, wait for closed cohorts, or decide the next orchestration step after every batch.
human_intent.desired_effect: Approach geometric/exponential-like growth in useful durable output by multiplying both parallel worker count and useful work per worker, while continuously improving the worker protocol from measured evidence.
not_the_goal: optimizing only Facultad or any single project
turning the human into a dispatcher
building coordination machinery that outgrows product output
human_intent.future_chat_requirement: A fresh /g must recover this mission from durable state, continue it rather than redesigning from scratch, persist material context/state changes before replying, and keep executing safe high-value work in the same turn until a real boundary or clear diminishing-return/context-safety limit is reached.

assist.rule: Only bounded non-overlapping assist children; helpers return evidence/candidates, while parent or later steward retains integration authority.

worker_exam.propagation_rule: Propagate reproducible protocol laws/behavior from the champion pattern, never a worker identity/persona.

scoreboard_semantics.champion: null until >=3 independent workers score >=8 with same non-null pattern_id

growth_control.truth_law: Do not call growth exponential from launches, PINs, commits, queue size or prose. Require durable productive units, breadth, successor reproduction, visible/user-relevant results and bounded coordination overhead.
growth_control.occupancy_rule: Use live product/assist frontier and active-capacity evidence; current campaign default is min(30, max(4, floor(product_or_assist_frontier * 0.5))). This is adaptive, not a ritual cap.
growth_control.anti_starvation: Do not let active product projects go two rolling windows without useful work when grounded executable work exists.
growth_control.next_window_gate: Do not scale raw launch count from intuition. First read launch measurement coverage, terminal classification, authority rate, productive units/launch and product/system/control value shares from one fresh v3.29 window.

on_fresh_g: Load this CURRENT_MISSION first after stable identity/epoch/continuity pointers.
Load GRW001 + gh-pages live/runtime.json + live/claim-frontier.json + live/worker-scoreboard.json when this mission is active.
Treat runtime/scoreboard as observability, durable PIN/RETURN/guide receipts/project STATE as authority/evidence.
Inspect what changed since last_guide_writeback; do not ask the human how many workers ran or to paste worker answers.
Evaluate best and worst worker patterns from evidence-backed exams/receipts; prefer mechanism changes that raise useful output per launched chat.
Keep the pool running during normal evaluation. Do not recreate stop-start 10-worker waves unless a measured safety/authority fault requires a bounded canary.
If a repeated systemic bottleneck is software-solvable, patch it once, guard it with the ratchet/tests when cheap, and continue product work.
Persist material changes to this mission/campaign/project state or a guide session receipt before the human-facing reply.
Do not end with an open-ended 'what next?'. State the already-derived next action or execute it when authorized.
A bare /g may not count a snapshot/status refresh as sufficient work when a grounded software-solvable multiplicative intervention exists.
After execution, update GUIDE_POWER_COMPASS_V1 and orient the human on compounding health, multiplicative alternatives, minimal file/experiment plan and real human load.
For a bare /g, persist the exact final visible response bytes and reference them from the session receipt before emitting that same text.
End every bare /g reply with the fixed utility footer: Guide Brief, Growth, 1–8 relevant page links with short current context/status, exact /wc prompt, HUMAN ACTION or NONE, and NEXT GUIDE CYCLE.
Use GDB001 /guide/ as the human-facing compiled place to inspect what the Guide is talking about; keep it a projection, not authority.
When the human prompt contains TAKEOVER CANARY TKV1, execute GUIDE_TAKEOVER_CANARY_V1 phases exactly and do not emit a reply before 30_FINAL + exact visible response exist.
Load GROWTH_TRAJECTORY_V1 immediately after Current Mission; use it to detect drift and choose the active roadmap/action-tree branch before local optimization.
Update the trajectory only on materially new empirical evidence, roadmap transition, major regression/correction, or human-coordination change; never append timestamp-only noise.
Include the stable Trajectory URL in every bare /g utility footer and explicitly distinguish product progress from system/control-plane progress.

When S3/EXP-STRATEGY-AB is active, load coordination/workers/WORKER_STRATEGY_EXPERIMENT_V1.json and scoreboard strategy_experiment_health. Do not derive another universal pattern solely from a high leader score.

Evaluate strategy variants only within the same job_class using post-ownership experimental-slot metrics; treat collisions/no-allocation as preclaim diagnostics and inspect exact receipts before any class-specific promotion.
Load coordination/workers/WORKER_GROWTH_POLICY_V1.json with the strategy experiment whenever v3.29 is current.
Read scoreboard measurement_coverage and growth_health before launch guidance; derived launch rows are observability only.
Treat S2/S3/S4/S5 as parallel mechanisms under the Growth Trajectory, not a serial checklist.
If growth_health.control_overhead_budget_state=PRESSURE, bias only comparable safe work toward PRODUCT_VALUE; critical rescue and authority/capability constraints still win.
If a worker has one grounded terminal residual, allow one bounded successor relay with an exact context capsule; never manufacture successors.
If human-launched /wc wakes occur but mappable v3.29 explicit exams omit experiment/class/variant evidence, repair the experiment wiring once instead of asking the human to route workers manually.
required_guide_behavior.autonomous_turn_depth: No arbitrary one-action or one-cycle cap. In a bare /g turn, continue safe high-value guide/steward actions while the tool/runtime context remains adequate. Stop only for a true human/authority/privacy/irreversibility boundary, no useful grounded work, or context quality no longer sufficient for safe continuation.
required_guide_behavior.no_background_claim: A chat does not self-wake after the turn; continuous pool workers still require the human or another proven launcher to open chats. Never pretend otherwise.

strategic_history.lesson: Finite 10-worker waves exposed routing/authority problems but made the human wait for slow tails and repeatedly ask what to do next.
Predeclared gates removed improvisation, but cohort barriers still serialized learning and production.
Workers could continue after premature CLOSE telemetry and later could retire after small fixed quotas while substantial frontier remained. Both behaviors wasted already-open capacity.
3 became checkpoint; target 6, cap 8; bounded assist children added so long safe work can expose parallel shards.

Normal production and evaluation are now concurrent. Workers join POOL PROD-01 continuously and terminal workers write evidence-backed exam cards; scoreboard learns which protocol pattern actually yields useful work.

Live must not mark a pool worker terminal merely because a CLOSE event exists. For pool members, terminal closure requires the terminal productivity exam card; otherwise continued durable work keeps the worker logically active and the premature CLOSE is an anomaly.

pool.note: Historical runtime only; do not derive a current numeric launch count from active=15.

frontier.note: Fresh compact frontier exposes value_class and exact postclaim source seeds.

scoreboard.truth_boundary: This window is the measured pre-v3.29 baseline. Derived launch rows do not supply strategy causality.

strategy_experiment.causal_boundary: explicit experimental slots within class only

occupancy.recommendation_basis: fresh frontier 12 -> ceil(12*1.25)=15; VERIFICATION EVIDENCE_DEPTH gap 3 with baseline authority 0.55 × explicit exam 0.45 -> ~13 attempts; choose max=15. Runtime occupancy remains stale, so 15 is a bounded approximate first v3.29 canary.
occupancy.before_return_to_guide: Launch approximately 15 identical canonical /wc chats, then return to /g for the first real v3.29 comparison window.

project_truth_refs.note: Project STATE.json files are the compact per-project brains. Do not infer current project state from this snapshot when a newer STATE exists.

anti_regression: Do not return to batch-stop-batch-stop as the default operating model.
Do not use 3 productive units as a terminal quota.
Do not declare a pool worker terminal without its exam card.
Do not reward verbosity or word count in worker quality.
Do not copy one apparent champion after a single lucky worker; require independent reproduction.
Do not let evaluation pause ordinary pool production.
Do not route every result through one privileged /g chat.
Do not make the human remember worker outputs, batch IDs, project routing or next-step logic.
Do not confuse infrastructure output with user/project output; keep infra share bounded.
Do not reopen known SOURCE_DEBT loops without genuinely new evidence.
Do not broadly scan beacons/PINs/returns repeatedly after ownership unless resolving one concrete contradiction.
Do not claim unattended continuous execution unless a separate proven launcher exists.
next_guide_actions: Before any worker handoff, continue all safe grounded same-turn Guide/repository work until only external /wc wake or a true human/authority boundary remains.
When only /wc wake remains, put the exact Current Mission worker prompt as the first visible copyable block and end with one mini line containing an evidence-based approximate count before return.
For the current first v3.29 canary, use ~15 identical /wc launches unless fresher evidence materially changes the frontier/sample pressure before handoff.
Consume the first fresh v3.29 PROD-01 launch window and verify that every durable beacon appears in launch_measurements.
If terminal classification remains materially below 0.95, repair the bounded close/measurement path before recommending a larger wave.
Use fresh post-ownership assignment_hint to fill underrepresented A/B variants without human routing; derived launch rows never count causally.
Run S4 capability specialization and S5 product-value dominance in parallel with S3; do not wait for a serial stage handoff.
When control-overhead budget is under pressure, prefer comparable grounded PRODUCT_VALUE work over optional additional control-plane work while preserving critical rescue.
Measure Context Capsule + Successor Relay by useful yield and grounded residual reuse; never create relay filler.
Keep external /wc as the known wake path until a separate launcher/runtime is actually proven.

last_guide_writeback.summary: Forged the launch-to-value pipeline: every durable beacon is measured, strategy causality remains explicit-exam-only, A/B fills underrepresented class variants post-ownership, S4/S5 run in parallel, exact-source context and one bounded successor relay are active canaries, pre-v3.29 baseline is durable, and relevant CI/public projections are verified.

continuity_verification.truth_boundary: This fresh /g proved Current Mission load -> current evidence audit -> useful state correction -> durable writeback without human reconstruction. It does not promote /w, declare a reproducible champion, or prove unattended self-wake.
continuity_verification.quality_truth_boundary: TKV1 proves fresh Guide STARTED -> ordered hydration -> material live-verified action -> durable state/Compass writeback -> exact literal response persistence -> FINAL marker. It does not prove unattended self-wake, current pool occupancy from stale runtime, /w promotion, Human Acceptance, or YIELD-10X champion reproduction.
continuity_verification.current_mission_extension_truth_boundary: Fresh bare /g loaded current mission/trajectory/evidence, detected and repaired stale experiment guidance, persisted durable writeback and required no recap. This does not prove unattended self-wake, production /w readiness or a reproducible worker champion.

literal_response_continuity.rule: Bare /g persists exact final response bytes before emitting them, and future /g may critique that literal response against durable actions/evidence.

guide_brief.purpose: Public human-readable compiled view of mission, compounding health, experiments, project states, online/review page links and canonical /wc prompt.

guide_takeover_canary.purpose: Verify a new /g writes STARTED, proves ordered hydration, executes material action, persists exact rich response, and only then replies.

growth_trajectory.purpose: North Star + empirical growth history + roadmap + anti-drift + action tree; prevents Guide strategy from depending on human reminders.
